title: Anchilops
summary: AN'CHILOPS, noun [Gr. a goat and an eye.] The goat's eye; an abscess in the inner angle of the eye; an incipient fistula lachrymalis.

inlines.v: AN'CHILOPS, noun [Gr. a goat and an eye.] The goat's eye; an abscess in the inner angle of the eye; an incipient fistula lachrymalis.
